item.title: The /teach skill is how AI should be used
item.description: In the software realm, agentic coding is a big thing now. Had been for a year and a half, and if you have been in that space recently, you might have used skills: markdown files that extends an agent’s capabilities by giving domain-specific information. You can give an agent a skill, for instance, for frontend design or test-driven development, augmenting that agent’s skillset. I was working on a coding-first learning platform the first quarter of this year which I dropped by the second quarter due to other responsibilities, when my boss sent me a link to the /teach skill around two months ago, as it seemed to align with my Code To Learn project, so I gave it a whirl.
